ETH.note: Fayda integration into services is only a plan; no authentication service is stated.
No civil register link is stated.
The brief announces an expansion of the e-tax system but does not state that tax is run on it in use across the administration.
No enrolment count or share is stated.
No number at birth is stated.
Operation and maintenance of the ID system are not stated.
Fayda is to be integrated into government services, not a named register.
Only a World Bank funding boost for Fayda is stated; no build or service status.

facts.fact: Addis Fortune reports the Ministry of Revenues announced an expansion of the e-tax system so that late and advance payments, partial filing and audit findings are handled through the digital platform.

Addis Fortune reports the Ministry of Revenues announced an expansion of its e-tax system to digitise services across tax bureaus, including partial document filing, and gave taxpayers a month to submit employee lists and contact details.
